name: Slay the Sector
author: Ubik
description: A Slay the Spire style roguelite inside your campaign. Fly to the Descent Relay, pick a faction and a 30 DP fleet, and fight down three Acts of branching battles, shops and events. Your real fleet waits untouched; only a credit Payout comes back. Works with modded factions and ships. BETA.
